scripts.start: npm run build:client && npm run serve
scripts.install:all: npm i && cd client && npm i && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
scripts.uninstall:all: rm -rf ./node_modules && cd client && rm -rf ./node_modules ./dist && cd ../server && rm -rf ./node_modules && cd ..
scripts.git_update: rm -rf ./node_modules && cd client && rm -rf ./node_modules ./dist && cd ../server && rm -rf ./node_modules && cd .. && git add . && git commit -m 'code update' && git push
scripts.dev: TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM --names "client,server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.test: TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp npm --prefix ./client run test 2>&1 | tee test-results.txt
scripts.test:client: TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp npm --prefix ./client run test 2>&1 | tee test-results.txt
scripts.test:server: TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp npm --prefix ./server run test 2>&1 | tee test-results.txt
scripts.test:all: { echo '=== CLIENT TESTS ===' && TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp npm --prefix ./client run test 2>&1; echo ''; echo '=== SERVER TESTS ===' && TMPDIR=$HOME/tmp npm --prefix ./server run test 2>&1; } | tee test-results.txt
scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p test-results && npm run test:all 2>&1 | tee test-results/full-run.log
